segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, this is Dana from Northstar Training. I'm reaching out again about invoice 104872 for July, because the 25-seat bundle is still showing twice, and this is the fourth time we've contacted you about the same thing not actually getting fixed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Hi Dana, I can help pull that up. Give me just a second in the billing tool. Is this for account NST-4421?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. The invoice total is $3,180, but it should be $2,240. The extra line is the Standard Users 25-pack for $940.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I see invoice 104872 dated July 1. There are two Standard Users 25-pack lines, both at $940, and then the platform fee and tax look normal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right. The last person said they removed the duplicate from the subscription setup after ticket 78216, but then the July invoice generated with it again.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I see the note on 78216. It looks like a credit was applied to the June invoice, but the underlying subscription record still has a second bundle attached with a renewal date of August 1. So that would explain why it came back.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, but we can't keep doing manual credits every month. Finance is asking me why this is still open.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. For today, I can submit a correction for the $940 duplicate on invoice 104872 and route the subscription cleanup to our billing operations queue. I'm adding the prior ticket references so they can see the pattern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you confirm it will be fixed before the August invoice runs?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can't honestly confirm that yet. I can mark it urgent and set the requested completion date for July 25, but billing operations has to remove that second bundle from the active subscription record.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do that, and send me the ticket number. We need something to show internally.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. The new ticket is 79344. You'll get an email in a few minutes with the invoice correction request and the subscription cleanup request noted. I'll also set a follow-up for July 24 to check status before the next billing cycle.
